Runtime libraries (never loaded from a CDN; copied into this folder with their licences)

hanzi-writer 3.7.3 (MIT, LICENSE-hanzi-writer.txt)
  hanzi-writer.esm.js = dist/index.esm.js of the npm package, unchanged (a self-contained ES
  module, no bare imports). Animates stroke order and quizzes stroke-by-stroke writing.
  The library's default character loader fetches a CDN; the app always passes charDataLoader
  with its own data (data/strokes/), so no request ever leaves the app's own files.

Stroke data (not a library): see data/strokes/README.txt.
